title: Have To (Obligation)
situation: Tasks that must be finished before the shift ends.
objective: Use have to to say what you must do at work.

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.english: Before I start the machine, I have to follow the SOP.
dialogue.indonesian: Sebelum menyalakan mesin, saya harus mengikuti SOP.

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.english: At the end of the shift, I have to write a short report.
dialogue.indonesian: Di akhir shift, saya harus menulis laporan singkat.

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.english: If a part is broken, I have to replace it with a new part.
dialogue.indonesian: Jika ada bagian yang rusak, saya harus menggantinya dengan bagian baru.

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.english: When the machine stops, we have to check it together.
dialogue.indonesian: Ketika mesin berhenti, kami harus memeriksanya bersama.

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.english: During a busy shift, I have to work quickly, but I do not have to skip any check.
dialogue.indonesian: Selama shift sibuk, saya harus bekerja cepat, tapi saya tidak perlu melewati pemeriksaan apa pun.

learningNotes: have to diikuti kata kerja bentuk dasar: have to check, have to write.
Hati-hati: do not have to berarti tidak perlu, bukan tidak boleh.
